quotes.text: Learn how to use Stripe Tax to calculate and collect taxes in your custom integration with Elements.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: This is a Checkout Sessions API for when api-integration is checkout.
This is a Payment Intents API for when api-integration is elements.
Stripe offers two ways to handle tax in custom payment flows. Choose based on how much control you need over tax reversals:
Stripe Tax only calculates tax in jurisdictions where you’re registered to collect tax.
The Tax API doesn’t automatically validate tax IDs against government databases.

findings: Semantic delta: the 2026-11-07 capture is a 14-line index with only a general purpose statement and two variant URLs (new raw lines 1-14); the diff replaces the older detailed body with index navigation (diff lines 1-16, 2597-2601). Baseline count error independent of the new capture: source-stripe-checkout-collect-taxes.md lines 138-143 and stripe-tax.md line 120 say 100+ types across 100+ countries. The old raw's country/type tables at lines 431-545 and 2445-2559 enumerate 107 country/type rows, 96 distinct country codes, and 80 distinct enum types; there is no stated 100+ countries or 100+ distinct types in that captured evidence.

The existing source has only the April raw in frontmatter and Raw Sources (source lines 4-8, 157-159). answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/advanced/tax, the complete November capture only identifies Stripe Tax for custom Elements integrations and routes to Checkout Sessions and Payment Intents variants (new raw lines 5-14); it establishes no current calculation, collection, payment-success, or beta-state contract. The April capture supplies dated detail: Checkout Sessions enables automatic_tax with tax classification and behavior (old raw lines 16-24), whereas the Payment Intents section distinguishes automatic tax handling from the custom Tax API for calculation, separate transaction recording, and reversals, subject to registration and payment-state timing (old raw lines 547-570, 879-898). The mapped source-stripe-checkout-collect-taxes.md retains both paths but incorrectly frames Payment Intents as only the full Tax API (source lines 11-13, 86) and overstates its table counts (source lines 138-143).
